title: nan
authors: Tong B.; Chen W.; Du L.
key_contribution: Presents a dilated convolutional neural network framework with low-cost IMUs and extended nonholonomic constraints for navigation in GNSS-denied traffic environments, validated on a GNSS/INS dataset.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
